description: Buxly Paints Limited traces its origin to 1933, when Khan Rahim Bux Khan began manufacturing paints in Hyderabad-Deccan, and to 1948, when the family set up the first paint factory in the new state of Pakistan. The company was incorporated in April 1954 and converted to a public limited company in 1985. Since 2000 its major shareholders' stake has been held by Slot-Rapid Limited of the United Kingdom, and Berger Paints Pakistan Limited owns 19% of the company. It makes decorative paints and specialised coatings including epoxies, polyurethanes and chlorinated rubber, and has supplied the Pakistan Army, Navy and Air Force.
